name: ListDataItem
description:
In addition to the properties defined below, you can define custom key-value pairs, which bind to
the child templates of an [ItemTemplate](api:ItemTemplate).  The key for these pairs match the `bindId` of
the child view templates and the values are a dictionary of view properties applied to the view components.
Any other properties that are not identified by a `bindId` are permitted but are ignored by the item template.

See [Titanium.UI.ListItem](api:Titanium.UI.ListItem) for examples of using a list data item.

properties.name: properties
properties.summary:
Contains key-value pairs of view properties and their values that are applied to the
`ListItem`.
properties.description:
If there are properties set in the [ItemTemplate](api:ItemTemplate) (not the children view templates),
the values set in the list data item override the template's properties.

properties.name: template
properties.summary:
Template ID configured with the [Titanium.UI.ListView.templates](api:Titanium.UI.ListView#templates) property or
[Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT).
properties.description:
On iOS, you can specify one of the following pre-defined templates:
[Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS),
[Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS) or [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE).
properties.default:
If the ListView's `defaultItemTemplate` property is not set,
then <Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT> is used.
